newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Seattle, Wash.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Seattle, Wash.

text.p: NOTICE OF BOND SALE
The City of Seattle
Washington
Water System Revenue Bonds, 1997
SEALEDBIDSwill be received by The City of Seattle,
Washington, at the offices of the Finance Director, 102
Municipal Building, 600 Fourth Avenue, Seattle, Washington,
until 11:00 a.m., Pacific Standard Time, on
March 18, 1997
or other date and time as may be communicated 24 hours in
advance. The bids will be acted on by the City Council at a
special meeting on March 18, 1997.
The Bonds will be dated March 15, 1997, and will be fully
registered, in book-entry form, initially registered in the
name of Cede & Co., as nominee for DTC. The Bonds will
mature on August 1 in the years 1997 through 2026.
Individual purchases of the Bonds will be made in the
denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof.
The Bonds shall be purchased at no less than 98.5 percent
of the aggregate principal amount. Interest rates that are
bid shall be in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of one percent, or
both, and no rate of interest for any maturity shall be less
than the rate of interest for a prior maturity.
The approving legal opinion of Foster Pepper & Shefelman,
Seattle, Washington, will be furnished, without cost, to the
purchaser of the Bonds. A no-litigation certificate will be
included in the closing papers.
Further information on the Bonds, and copies of the
complete Official Notice of Sale, Official Bid Form and
Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained, upon
request, from the City's financial advisor, Seattle-
Northwest Securities Corporation (206) 628-2882.
Finance Director
(From The Bond Buyer)
